notes: 1x RGBA, nearest, no baked shadow/glow (wall AO stays game-side). Pick variant per cell with a hash of (x, y) like art3 does.

sheets.row0: left-wall inner face (wall on left, room on right)
sheets.maps_to: art3.bake_room side faces (currently 6px vstones face beside '#' cells)
sheets.anchor: top-left; left face at (X+T, Y) of the wall cell, right face at (X-SIDE, Y). Height covers cell + FACE so it meets the front-face run.
sheets.change: 8px wide (was 6), lit rim on room edge, dithered falloff into the wall for depth

sheets.maps_to: garden dirt patches (art3.bake_floor_np garden dirt mask) - fill dirt-mask cells with these instead of palettised noise
sheets.change: 3-tone tileable ordered-dither dirt, sparse pebbles, occasional grass sprig; no large blotches

sheets.maps_to: garden dirt cells (art3 dirt_cells) - REPLACES dirt_floor.png for gardens
sheets.index_rule: col = N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8 where each bit = that 4-neighbour cell is also a dirt cell; row = variant (thash(cx,cy) % 2)
sheets.blend: RGBA: interior opaque, sides facing non-dirt fade out with irregular dithered alpha so the game's noise dirt/grass shows through. Blit with normal alpha over the baked noise floor. Isolated cells (col 0) become organic blobs, not squares.
sheets.palette: same 4 colours as art3 garden noise dirt

sheets.maps_to: room 83 (King's Secret Room, 'walls are many colours') '#' wall tops

top-left, directly below the wall top

same cells/positions as each room83 base sheet
sheets.use: EMISSIVE: draw after the darkness/lighting overlay (dark_full / dark_lit) at the same positions as the base wall tiles, normal alpha blend (or BLEND_ADD). Never darkened. Optional twinkle: modulate alpha by 0.6-1.0 per tile with a slow sine.
FALLBACK: drop-in replacement for the base sheets if no emissive pass is added (base lifted ~28% toward white). With the emissive pass, keep the normal base sheets.
